reviews.text: Kind & wonderful vet + reception staff..

I can not fault the service The Vets have given us. From routine visits to unforeseen illnesses, our pets have been looked after with both great care and professionalism. And they take good care of the humans too 😊

Bad experience, don’t trust them what they explain verbally.
Read form properly when signed and see cost attached to each single item.
They will charge for every single thing even for compulsory things which needed during surgery etc
Careful when you drop your pet.

Good afternoon Pat,

Thank you for your 5 star review, we are very glad you and your lovely pets are happy with us. It is always a pleasure to see you all. 

Many thanks, 

Kirsty - The Pet Vet Waltham Forest
Fantastic professional treatment. Very pleasant friendly comfortable atmosphere in the clinic. Would definitely recommend

Good morning Nicholas,

Thank you for your review and 5 stars, we really appreciate you taking the time to leave this. We hope you and Kiki continue to have a good experience with us. 

We are very mindful of the cost of pet ownership and work hard to offer excellent value for money for all our products and services. We also offer a price match guarantee so if you are able to purchase your medication at a lower price elsewhere, we will refund the difference. If you have any questions or concerns regarding pricing, please feel free to ask our team. 

Many thanks,

Kirsty - The Pet Vet Waltham Forest

Staff are very friendly and always make a fuss over my dog. Katarina, the head vet, impressed me from the word go. She's professional,  very thorough and caring.  Her diagnosis is always spot on. She  explains things clearly and patiently.  I am an anxious owner, but she's always been very pleasant and patient with me in answeing my long list of questions. I never felt rushed.

Areas of improvements include: 1.speeding up the insurance Claims process ; 2. relocating the  St. Francises room to a discreet area to give owners more privacy. It's also upsetting to see owners coming out distressed; 3. Re-establishing a reception area.

Overall, I am happy with this practice - spacious and clean, friendly staff,  but most importantly,  a brilliant head vet!
My appointment was for 14:45, there was about a 15 minute delay to get seen.
Always good service ,feel confident taking my dog there they love Millie she gets so much attention, but she is adorable. The reception staff and vets are all lovely
Wonderful service with great a welcoming front of house team

Bring dog today i knew need do xray  .Ask for price 800 £  and for that say it was consultation...another  60£  do u really mad ...never ever  again gonna use this clinic ..over priced . 1 minutes  at vet cost £60.
It’s a brilliant place to take your pets if sick or general check up the only down side is it’s very expensive
Helpful

RIP Off,
I have 3 cats with them for over 6 years, I have one of my cats teeth removed and was quoted a price, I was then told it had to be done iin 2 sittings after the 1st one they have demanded I pay the same amount again for the next extraction, AVOID as they have changed ownership and now are all about the money there is no customer service.
Caring helpful and highly professional people very clean vet

I am deeply saddened and to leave this review after being a loyal client at this Walthamstow practice for over four years. I always trusted them as per their communication as being a family-owned clinic with integrity. Tragically, their policies have secretly changed behind the scenes, and they now use your love for your pet to exploit you financially. My dog Lola had an elbow lump. I was charged a £60 consultation fee, plus an astounding £250 for a routine Fine Needle Aspiration (FNA) test. When I researched the extreme markup and challenged it, the Head Vet sent a lengthy justification explaining that the £250 covered the vet’s time, expertise, and clinical assessment to see if the test was needed.
This is an absolute mockery. Those are the exact services a £60 consultation fee is designed to cover. They essentially double-billed me for the same 5-minute appointment under a hidden diagnostic fee. When I called them out on this double-charging, the manager completely ignored the question. I have agreed to receive a refund for the FNA, as i don't want to be blindly and abruptly. I have essentially paid £60 for a "consultation" that provided absolutely zero answers, no medical guidance on what the lump could be, and completely wasted my time. They took my money and left my dog with no care. Do not trust their branding; their integrity is completely gone.
Excellent service very friendly staff. Very nice reception waiting area
Took my cat Odin in to be castrated the staff were lovely talked me through everything and were very care and helpful
Very friendly and caring vets practice. My cat Mimi is a bit of a nightmare to examine. They did a fantastic job.

My dog had a serious allergy affecting her head and neck, and then a lot of vomiting as a side effect of the steroids that she was on for a couple of weeks. We received very good treatment on each visit to the practice. Vets and staff are caring and helpful.  Willow is now fully recovered, and we are very grateful to the team.

Hi Katy,

Thank you for taking the time to leave us a review. We are glad you and Rosie have had a positive experience with us and hope you continue to do so.

Many thanks,

Kirsty - The Pet Vet Waltham Forest
Very polite very helpful even ask if you want a coffee.  Great .
Amazing vets my cat is 13 and I thought when I took her to the vet I wouldn't be coming home with her but the vets prescribed meds and now she is on the mend so happy

Very good info given to me
Just one thing can you bring the reception desk back if no one to meet you your just standing there

My last visit was to collect medication which I had been told was ready, but I had to wait 10-15 minutes before I got it, and it clearly wasn't ready! I wouldn't mind ... except this happens nearly every time!!
Having said this, in all other respects this vet surgery is excellent - caring, up-front and honest about costs. I would recommend them highly.

we have used Pet Vet for our beloved Harley for many years and the staff have always been lovely to us and him.   We sadly had to make the difficult decision a couple of weeks ago and we could not have been looked after better.   Harley was treated with dignity and respect, as were we and the four of us were able to spend those last precious moments with him.

A mention to Alice and Laura who guided us every step of the process with empathy and kindness.

Fly free Harley
Big thumbs for Gina who was fantastic with my elderly dog who can be nervous. Very knowledgable too. Thank you

I recently registered our 2 new rescue kittens at The Pet Vet after such a positive experience with  our very poorly chinchilla (despite our dog being registered with a different local vet). The staff are so friendly, professional and helpful and they’re probably the only independently owned vets left in the wider area.  The whole experience from start to finish has been impressive and I would highly recommend them.

Hi Jimmy,

Thank you so much for your 5 star review. We are so glad you and Maggie had a good experience with us and we really appreciate you taking the time to share your review. 

Many thanks,

Kirsty - The Pet Vet Waltham Forest

Poor service and unclear pricing. The explanations given were confusing, and it often felt like if you didn’t fully understand, that was your problem rather than theirs. I was never given a clear idea of how much I would be paying, and the final bill came as a surprise. There are no prices displayed anywhere, making it impossible to know the cost of treatment in advance.
The overall impression I got was that they already have plenty of customers and don’t seem particularly concerned about improving the customer experience. After reading other reviews, I realized I wasn’t the only one who felt this way. I completely understand the concerns raised by reviewers such as Aiyza, Muge, and Les. Like them, I found that you never really know what the final cost will be until the end.
I also noticed that the response to almost every negative review is simply asking the customer to get in touch, rather than publicly addressing the concerns that were raised. That didn’t give me much confidence.
If you’re concerned about your budget, I’d recommend looking around first. There are many other veterinary practices that are more affordable, provide friendlier service, and are much more transparent about their pricing.
Never had a bad experience here. The receptionists are always friendly  and eager to help. The surgery has recently been up dated and looks nice.

Hi Glen,

Thank you for your 4 star review. We would love to discuss your experiences with you if you could get in contact with us as I am having difficulty finding you on our system. 

Thank you again!

Kirsty - The Pet Vet Waltham Forest

The vets were very friendly and supportive when my cat was ill and sadly passed but they saw her straight away when first phoned but sadly passed away with old age but they were supportive and caring throughout.
Blue light card holders ONLY GET A DISCOUNT..  ON Wednesday and Thursday's from june 2026.
I had to put my old cat down. The lady and the vet were extremely supportive. The vet wrapped the body and brought Batman out to my car. Thank you

On my last visit the customer service was non existent.  I arrived 10 mins before my appointment, checked in yet and was then ignored. After 45 mins I enquired as to when I might be seen and was told hat they were busy.  After a further 20 mins I had no interaction with any member of staff so gave up and went home.  You spend a lot of time cooing over dogs but forget about the rest.  If you have time for that then you have time to communicate.  Fair enough if you have issues but let waiting customers know.  Not even a phone call after with an apology.
Wonderful staff wonderful service could not have trusted my pet with a better vets. Thank you all so much.

Excellent service from the team. My cat had an infection and was seen straight away. The vet carried out a thorough assessment, gave injections, and provided oral medication during the visit. Friendly, efficient, caring, and very cost effective. Highly recommend.

Today I just want to say a huge thank you to Helen at The Pet Vet Waltham Forest, Higham Park & Walthamstow (Waltham Forest)
The Pet Vet 🐾

This was a completely new vets for us — we’d never been there before — and if I’m honest, I went in a bit guarded. I’ve dealt with far too many vets over the years who don’t listen, who assume they know better, or who make you feel like you’re being dramatic.

So to finally speak to someone who was kind, calm and actually listened… it was honestly so refreshing.

Sheba is 12 now. We’re in those final months — and if I get another year with her, I know we’ve been incredibly lucky. Her legs are getting worse and we needed a refill of pain relief, and I’ll be honest, I was expecting a battle.

But Helen was just brilliant.

No judgement.
No ego.
No “I know best” attitude.

She listened to me, trusted that I know my own dog, and worked with me to make sure Sheba is comfortable. And that’s all you want at this stage — dignity, comfort, and support.

The vet industry needs more Helens. 💛

Thank you for making a really hard chapter just that little bit easier.

The care is excellent at this vet practice. My reason for giving it only 3 stars is that the prices are now so high that it has become unaffordable and I have left for Snoots. I have been with this practice since my 12 year old dog was a puppy, and have been pleased, I now simply cannot afford their fees.  Staff members are totally wonderful, and deserving of special mentions are Sharon, Talia, Sue, Sapphire and Ella. All are really kind, and lovely people who are very good at their jobs.
Staff are always helpful and patient. They will always try to accommodate owners and pets.
Very friendly and helpful with Beau, 6/5

Sapphire was brilliant when registering my new puppy. Appointment booked for today for 1st vaccination, payment seemed reasonable, payment scheme was good and much better initial impression than vetcall in station road.
Wonderful vet practice. Friendly and professional staff. Appointments booked easily and real care shown.

Whats not to love, our dog can't wait to go inside and see the staff! Always kind, patient and extremely knowlegeable about all things pets! Could not recommend them more. When the dog was seriously ill they took good care of him and recommended other vets that would be able to better look after him - its not often you get such honesty these days! Would deffinatly recommend for anyone with a pet
Love these guys My previous Vet would not operate on my dog for over a year. These guys operated within two weeks.

Significant decline in standards - stay away!

I have been bringing my cat to this practice since he was a kitten - he is now nearly 11 years old. When it was known as The Vet, the standard of care was good. However, since the rebranding to Pet Vet and the change in ownership, the quality has declined significantly. I was a long‑standing client and recommended countless people to this practice, something I now genuinely regret.

The layout is poorly designed, and the reception process is very disorganised. On my most recent few visits I waited for around ten minutes with no acknowledgement from any staff member. Despite their stated procedure that “we’ve introduced deskless receptions in all of our surgeries to allow our client experience coordinators to offer a more personalised approach to both our customers and pets” - I can assure you that this has never happened. Staff remain in a small office area, leaving clients standing for ages without any communication or guidance.

The administrative side is equally poor. No proper invoice or breakdown of costs is provided. Only a basic transaction receipt. There have been times where the receptionists have been confused whether a deposit had been taken or not, and no one seemed able to explain it properly. For a veterinary practice, this level of confusion and lack of transparency is unacceptable.

The clinical care has also declined. Routine examinations are no longer thorough, and important issues are being missed. My cat’s plaque build‑up on his teeth (something that should have been identified/ seen during a standard check) was overlooked entirely, resulting in an unnecessary return visit and additional cost.

I have since moved to a reputable veterinary practice in Chingford, and the difference in professionalism, communication, and attention to detail was immediate and significant. If you love your pets, please stay away!

The vet station fixed my pointers ACL in her left leg. They quoted 1000 less than other vets and Vanessa who operated on my Pointer in 2023  so far has succeeded in giving my Pointer a happy and energetic life, off the lead all the time I am concerned but let her do what she wants to do. Hunt . Thanks to Vanessa she is a very happy dog 14 months in Cornwall on the beach and now back in Wimbledon spending every day running wild on the common. A massive Thank you. However  the insurance wouldn’t pay out!!!!  Shocking any excuse and this will deter any pet owner. It’s the insurance companies that will stop people from owning pets . Honestly I wouldn’t have another dog. I rented a room out in my house and scraped to pay for her op. £5000 !!! Took me a year to pay it off and I had insurance. That was cheeper than any other vet. Insurance for pets is shocking they won’t pay when ever they can get away with it. I pray she doesn’t do the other leg .🤞
Brilliant vets- easy to get appointments, great vets and super helpful reception staff, Sharon is wonderful!

Appointment was booked a week in advance, yet I was made to wait over one hour. Reception claimed they operate “like A&E” due to a few emergencies. Fine — except I was explicitly told I would be next, and then another woman who arrived 5 minutes earlier was called in immediately.

I left after wasting an hour of my day. This is poor organisation, inconsistent explanations, and a total lack of professionalism. If this is how scheduled appointments are handled, be honest and say so upfront.

My appointment it was at 11:15 I see him at 11:45 he didn’t done nothing for my cat  I wonder for the first injection hidden the injection he said come back on Friday and they charge me 72£ 55£ just bc he touch my heart I will never ever go back there again, first time for the last time

I have been going there for about four years, starting with my older cat. I always knew their services were expensive, but I never avoided spending money because I thought they took good care of my pet. That was until I got my second cat. She’s just a baby, and she had discharge in her eye, so I went in with that complaint.

They looked at her eye and gave me antibiotic drops, then told me to come back. I went for a second visit, but the problem continued. They suggested a test, but they couldn’t guarantee anything. Since it was very expensive, I postponed it. Then they told me to keep using the drops, which I did exactly as instructed.

Later, the color of the discharge changed, so I took her again. This time another doctor examined her. They poured some liquid to check the eye but still couldn’t see any issue. Honestly, they seemed to have no idea what they were doing because they were searching on the internet right in front of me — unbelievable! The doctor suggested the test again, and I finally agreed. We did the test, and everything came back clear.

By that point, I had already spent £680, and my cat’s eye was still the same…

Then I researched with ChatGPT, and it suggested that her tear duct might be blocked. I went back to the vet again and asked if this could be the problem. They said “maybe” and checked and it turned out her tear duct was blocked. They recommended surgery, and I agreed. She had the surgery, but the problem still wasn’t solved.

Today we had an appointment. I was 15 minutes late, and they refused to take me in. The staff (Sue) were singing Christmas songs and having fun with the elderly man in front of me, but when she saw me, she didn’t even smile. Even though the clinic was empty, she told me they were “fully booked” and turned me away. (Not to mention, they never saw us on time for a single appointment, even though we always arrived punctually.)

So I’m asking this business: Are you really here to help these tiny lives, or are you just running a money-making operation? My cat has been traumatized, and I have suffered both financially and emotionally. And I’m telling everyone: this place is nothing but a business — do NOT go there!!
Called this vet to try and get an appointment for my sick dog, receptionist was very rude, unprofessional, uncaring and hung up on me.

I cannot praise this practice enough, I recently had to have my dog put to sleep, a devastating decision but all the staff showed nothing but care and kindness, real compassion. Ensuring his passing was as gentle as possible. Thank you to the whole team.
Appointment booked on online portal, good service and nice staff.
It was an amazing experience. Very helpful, polite and knowledgeable staff.

Always friendly, always ts easy to get an appointment. Open and zoned inviting waiting area. Vets are helpful and willing to give you time. Happy to explain things again. I even got a follow up email outlining my care plan and options. So lucky to have you just around the corner.
Thank you for your 5 star review Monika. Best wishes, Stephanie at The Pet Vet Waltham Forest.
The surgery is amazing! They give the best advice , have polite, helpful staff and I wouldn’t go anywhere else!
Saw a lovely new nurse today for my cat Tito's annual boosters.  He's a tad overweight and we had a really good discussion about alternative foods and strategies.  Very helpful indeed.
Always had great service at this vet.
Thank you for your kindness and support today as we said goodbye to our beloved cat Dave. You were thoughtful and generous with your care . Thank you again x

Last night, I found a box of abandoned kittens at a bus stop and took them in. When I called this morning for guidance, Sharon and the vet nurse whose name I unfortunately did not get jumped at the chance to assist. I am so grateful for organisations like this in my community and thank them immensely for their support and kindness, even encouraging me to check in later this week (I got attached to one ... oops).
Excellent, friendly and efficient service. Such a wonderful practice where all the staff are so lovely and make you feel at ease as well as your pet. Highly recommend

When your pet is very sick they 'manipulate you' into spending large amounts of money to do these expensive procedures that costs thousands of pounds that you do not need.  They are only interested in making money to reach their targets!!  Disgusting people...do not take my word for it..after you register with them, you will see how they only care about making money!!
Thank God I found a vet that cares....KEEP AWAY FROM THESE DISGUSTING PEOPLE...
Great vet experience - recently took both cats there and will definitely return.
Bailey is a very enthusiastic young golden retriever who badly cut his leg .. the whole team at The Vets were quick to treat him and treated him with kindness and patience.. I’m very happy with them.
Caring, friendly staff who treated my dog with the kindness and professionalism he deserves
Nicely refurbished, family-friendly reception area. Welcoming staff and very friendly, knowledgeable veterinarian. Thank you!

Myself and Dolly are very grateful for the emergency care she received yesterday
She was operated on within 2 hours of our visit
Lewis the vet was amazing Vet Nurse Kate and Sapphire are so kind
Thank you for saving Dolly's life

I recently took my happy and friendly Pomchi Coco to Vets Waltham Forest for her annual vaccination 24 September at 8am, and I couldn’t be more pleased with the experience. The appointment ran on time, and the vet was incredibly compassionate and attentive. They gave her lots of cuddles and attention, and even treated her to her favourite liver paste, which made the visit enjoyable for her. Despite having to wear a muzzle, she showed no anxiety, which speaks volumes about how comfortable the vet made her feel. I really appreciate the level of care they provided for my fur baby. Highly recommend this vet!
This is a great Vets.I have recently discovered them and moved both my cats there. They are open at the weekend, which is a bonus. Animals always seem to fall ill on a Friday night!
So kind great with Isla
Hi Hazel, thank you so much for leaving a 5 star review. We are glad the teams hard efforts do not go unnoticed! Best regards, Stephanie at The Pet Vet Waltham Forest.

I agree Jemma, absolutely all about money since they took over. They never tell you upfront what the cost will be or if there will even be a cost! Yesterday evening I took my cat in to look at a tiny discharge in one eye. I was in the room for about 7 mins, but as I'm going away for a few days and therefore there would be noone to administer her eye drops 4 x per day, we agreed I should come back on my return for the drops if the issue is still there.I know she plans to charge again!
I was totally shocked when told that 7 min session in which she did nothing , cost £52!!!!!
No wonder people don't bother to go to the vets anymore,  how can they afford that!? Horrendous extortion.
If anyone knows of any more reasonable vets in the area (within a 10 mile radius of Walthamstow) please share.

Terrible and distressing experience. We’ve been with this vet for 7 years, but over the last year they’ve become completely money-focused.

We were given misleading advice regarding our dogs ACL injury, told we needed to pay £6000 for surgery immediately with no real explanation for the injury or the treatment. We went to a physiotherapist for a second opinion who gave clear and helpful explanations, a thorough treatment plan which resolved the issue, for a fraction of the cost.

However, the most significant issue, is that the passing of our dog was handled appallingly. I would urge anyone not to trust them with their pets, especially as such a heart breaking time. We have never not paid a bill in the 7 years, even when it’s been tough, so the sudden prioritisation of money over compassion felt totally uncalled for.

They sent us the bill asking for payment for his passing within minutes of us leaving, whilst pushing his empty stroller home. Despite seeming completely insensitive timing we paid immediately. They also said they would email the cremation options within 2 days.

They then took 8 days to send us a bill for cremation — and they chose to send it on a Saturday afternoon. Then, less than 24 hours later at 9am on a Sunday morning, we got a cold phone call demanding payment, while our dog’s body was effectively held hostage until we paid. It felt cruel and transactional. Totally ruining a family occasion for us all.

Where had our poor boy been for the last two weeks since he passed? We had been told he would go off straight away and be back in a couple of weeks. The receptionist couldn’t tell us where he was. All she said was “it’s protocol” and that we could complain if we wanted — showing absolutely no compassion. Alba, the vet, had shown such care and warmth during his passing, we felt comfortable leaving him with her. Now we felt that he was just a way of making money for this company, and that care stopped once we left the building.

No one should ever be treated this way, especially when they’re already heartbroken over losing their beloved pet. Absolutely shameful.

Absolutely amazing care & brilliant staff,  the whole team from reception staff, nurses, vets and everyone else that makes this team work so well. We've been using these vets since our dog, Seamus, was a puppy and he's now 8. Most recently he had a teeth clean, we were initially worried about the general anesthetic but the team were so well informed and happy to advise us that it put us totally so at ease so we decided to go ahead with it. The whole process from first booking to the aftercare and updates on the day to was amazing, excellent communication. Our dog ended up needing 4 teeth out and I had 3 calls from a nurse (and one conversation with a vet) on the day to keep me informed of his well-being and to explain the need for his treatment. We felt so secure and happy that he was being loved and cared for as a family member. The bill was also a lot less than we had anticipated which I think is another measure of their professionalism and love for animals. In essence, a brilliant professional vets that we are so grateful for and very happy to recommend. 5 stars!

First of all big shout out to Sharon and Saphire, they are so lovely. Wanted to cuddle them. Love this vet praxis and already my second time here. Unlike many others in London here they pick up the phone and are super friendly! Gets better, they even have appointments on short notice or within a few days. Alba the Spanish vet is a real gem too. Our Cat Kuhni was very at ease. Having great employees like these really shines through and makes it an experience to remember.
The Vet was excellent with my cat Molly having a health check and she was also helpful to administer her wormer tablet upon my request. Reception staff were friendly and helpful too.

Got a same-day appointment for my rabbit, which was a relief even though no small animal specialist was available that day. Sharon at reception was lovely as always, and the vet who saw us was friendly, patient, and answered all my questions. Loved seeing free rabbit food samples in the waiting area, and it was great to be able to get the medication and supplies I needed right at the clinic.
We had Freya as a vet nurse recently and she was very lovely and considerate. She went above and beyond for my dog.

Operation day all went as explained and although our Alsatian split some stitches with her rough play the aftercare continued untill she was signed off as successfully healed and biting any logs stones she could yet again
5*
A last-minute visit after my small dog swallowed a dropped ibuprofen tablet. They fitted me in and we were dealt with very quickly.
The practice is very brightly coloured. And well organised for visiting with pets. Staff are welcoming and friendly and interactive with the pets and are confident in dealing with queries.
Lulu is a very nervous rescue dog and the staff are always very kind and patient.

A wonderful experience. All the staff were so friendly, knowledgeable and helpful. They made sure I understood what the treatment involved and the aftercare. Nice open clinic as well.
Highly recommend
I have been taking my cat to The Pet Vet practice for some years now, vets, nurses and admin staff they are all polite, attentive and doing brilliant job. I am happy that found this place :)
The staff are absolutely amazing and made such a fuss of my dog.
Friendly staff, great pet care
I recommend The Pet Vet to all my friends and family!

Im bringing my cat there and despite the vet service is amazing, I will say the admin service is super disappointing.
They are lovely in the reception but
Is take AGES they do a claim with the insurance. I sent my claim 28th of July, and I'm still waiting any reply. And is happening to me all the time I did a claim. They took like 15 days when is something faster.
Hopefully they improve this service.

Hi Inga, We’re unable to locate any recent appointments or an account on our database with the information provided here. If you can email walthamforest@thepetvet.co.uk at your earliest convenience we will be able to assist. Kind regards, Stephanie at The Pet Vet Waltham Forest.
Highly recommended! The atmosphere at the clinic was very friendly and calm. Everyone was kind and helpful, and the vet explained everything in detail. I truly felt that my pets were in good hands.

Fantastic vet that I've been using since my 6 year old husky Tama was a pup. We get yearly reminders that her vaccines are due, the staff are very personable, in particular, Sapphire who has incredible customer service which makes our entire visit relaxing and welcoming. Sapphire kept calm and easily rearranged one of my appointments in a pinch when i was very stressed, and i couldnt be happier with the service they provide overall
Absolutely recommend!!!
Prefer the old layout with a reception counter. It now feels a bit too clinical and not as welcoming.
They are the best vets hands down. Always willing to fit you in always very understanding and not over priced have recommended to everyone.

I always have a positive experience when I visit. Staff members are friendly and professional, the waiting area is spacious and separated for cats and dogs which my cat Cleo probably appreciates, appointments run to schedule. Thanks
The staff are very friendly and helpful. Our vet Alba absolutely adores our greyhounds and can’t stop giving them hugs, cuddles and treats.
Really happy with the service we receive here. Recommended.
Great service, friendly and helpful vet and staff, very accommodating and comprehensive. All sorted and we felt well looked after, thank you.
Always so kind and accommodating, flexible times and availability for appointments and brilliant clear communication. Amazing care for my cat Cosmos

I write this review with a heavy heart. Today i had to do something that i have never in my 23 years of life had to do. I had to put my beloved kitten of 7 weeks to sleep due to her low chances of survival because of a heart condition due to a birth defect. Today was emotionally and physically a very stressful and scary day having told that the kitten may have to be put to sleep. The staff members in this vet are AMAZING and COMPASSIONATE people who have helped me through this today. The moment i stepped in to see the kitten for the last moments we were taken into a grief room to spend our last moments and we had the chance to ask anything to the lovely lady. They really all know how to do their job properly and i really highly respect them because it is not an easy job! They know how to care for pets compared to other experiences i have had at other vets. They always follow the standards of pet care values and i will forever admire them for that. Thank you for your amazing care and i wish nothing but wellness and happiness for you all. 🤍🥰

All the staff are very friendly and welcoming to humans and pets equally. The area is always clean and tidy. The nurses are very thorough and provide plenty of support with extra details and information to guide you. I would highly recommend The Pet Vet to anyone.
friendly staff always willing to help.

Was in the vet practice for 1 hour supposed to have been seen 12.30 but nearer to 1pm
Out at 1.30pm with no medication as out of stock. Told to come back on the Monday to pick up, no call. Tried calling Wednesday morning, asked to hold waited listening to music for more than 10 mins then told she would look into this and call back with the hour no call. Called again, asked to hold waited listening, waited 15 mins listening to music, had to hang up the phone. Still no meds so will now have to go done in person to the vets.

My dog having ripped her dew claw was in a lot of pain. I called The Pet Vet at 8am and was asked is it an emergency? I told them yes and explained, initially I was given a 9.15 appointment which I agreed to albeit reluctantly but was immediately contacted back to say the vet had opened up an appointment at 8.15 which I readily agreed to and the vet sorted out the problem very speedily. It was such a relief to have such efficient and caring treatment both to myself and especially to my dog. Well Done! Pet Vet

Thank you for your review. It is much appreciated! We would love to hear how we could improve our services for a 5 star review - feel free to share your feedback to walthamforest@thepetvet.co.uk and one of our customer experience co-ordinators will get in touch. Many thanks, Stephanie at The Pet Vet Waltham Forest.
There was a mix up with the date of my appointment but they made sure my cat saw a vet that day without much of a wait. The vet was caring and helpful.
Always lovely caring staff who adore Millie wouldn't go anywhere else
The Pet Vet are always friendly my Yorkie poo has anxiety but he is calm when he has to see the vet.staff are always polite & reassuring thank you Pet Vet Ernie's mum
Friendly staff and open evenings and weekends making this practise very accessible .

We strongly advise people not to sign up to this vet's pet plan. We did and have paid dearly for it. A few days before Xmas we attended a scheduled appointment to collect flea and wormer treatment (we were told on the phone that this was ready for collection). On arrival we were told we couldn't be given this until our dog had his annual check up (3 months into the contract). We had not been informed of this in advance. This meant we weren't able to get our dog flea treated or wormed before going away for Xmas. We cancelled the Pet Plan after paying for 3 months, attending 3 appointments & having to buy our own flea treatment and wormer in the 3rd month. We then received a bill for £120. It's impossible to understand what this was for. We had to pay, as we were threatened with bailiffs. We have asked to speak to a manager on countless occasions but this hasn't been an option for us. This has been stressful and time-consuming. It feels like a horrible scam. We will never go back to this vet.
